department: School of Science — Department of Mathematics

deadline.value: Fall 2027-28 deadline for both non-local and local full-time applicants is June 1, 2027 (rolling admissions; HKPFS deadline December 1, 2026).
deadline.quote: For 2027/28 Fall Term Intake (commencing in Sep 2027): | Non-local Applicants* | Full-time: 1 Jun 2027 | Local Applicants | Full-time: 1 Jun 2027 | Admissions is on rolling basis.

gre_subject.value: Not required centrally (FYTGS states GRE/GMAT is normally required only by Business and Management programs); Mathematics catalog and admissions pages list no GRE Subject requirement.
gre_subject.quote: Required only if there is a Program-Specific Requirement on public examination achievements, e.g. GMAT, GRE | GMAT and GRE are normally required by Programs in the School of Business and Management only

supervisor.value: Mathematics PG admissions and 2027-28 catalog pages do not state a pre-application supervisor contact requirement.

funding.value: Department states all current PhD and MPhil students receive full financial support since arrival via four-year Postgraduate Scholarships (HK$229,620/yr centrally) and fellowships, contingent on good progress and teaching performance.
funding.quote: All of our current PhD and MPhil students have been on full financial support in the form of postgraduate scholarship and fellowships since their arrival. | We offer a four-year Postgraduate Scholarship, contingent on good progress in the program and competent performance of teaching duties.

also.quote: Postgraduate Studentship (PGS) | HK$229,620 per year (~US$29,420/ year) | Up to 4 years for full-time PhD students

entry_route.value: Admits bachelor's holders with outstanding performance (4-year full-time PhD) and research master's holders (3-year full-time PhD).
entry_route.quote: Full-time: 3 years (with a relevant research master’s degree), 4 years (without a relevant research master’s degree) | Applicants seeking admissions to a doctoral degree program should have obtained a bachelor’s degree with a proven record of outstanding performance from a recognized institution

notes: Students specialize in one of three core tracks: Pure Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, or Probability and Statistics (with optional Scientific Computation Concentration).
